svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: TMC5160A pinout, TQFP-48
svg.desc: Pinout of the TMC5160A in TQFP-48, top view: 48 pins and an exposed pad, each with its name, its electrical type as a colour and the driver hook that uses it.
svg.text: Top view, pin 1 marked. Colour is the pin's electrical type; the mono text outside is the port hook the driver uses for it. Datasheet: 2.1 Package Outline, p. 11.
